Subject: MAP draft - vendor onboarding & procurement steps

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (20260224_MAP-draft.xlsx) so we have agreed milestones and owners for vendor onboarding/procurement. Please review and confirm the items below or flag any changes.

MAP milestone: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (high level)
- Step 1: Vendor profile creation in Coupa/Ariba (Owner: Acme procurement; Redwood: provide vendor details sheet) — Target: 2026-03-05
- Step 2: Vendor forms and compliance questionnaire (Owner: Acme procurement; Redwood: complete vendor form + SOC2 summary) — Target: 2026-03-05
- Step 3: Tax doc (W-9) & banking details for ACH (Owner: Acme finance) — Target: 2026-03-05
- Step 4: Legal review of MSA/order form (Owner: Acme Legal; Redwood Legal) — Target: 2026-03-10
- Step 5: PO issuance & payment terms finalization (Owner: Acme finance) — Target close: 2026-03-15

Dependencies / blockers:
- Which procurement system will you use (Ariba vs Coupa)? If Coupa, we may need a supplier invitation link from your side so we can populate Redwood's vendor record.
- If finance requires specific W-9 format or vendor questionnaire, please attach — I’ve included our W-9 (ACME_W-9.pdf) and a blank vendor detail template in the MAP.

Responsibility summary:
- Acme: initiate vendor profile, share vendor form, supply W-9 & banking details, legal redlines
- Redwood: complete vendor form on our side, provide SOC2 summary, provide vendor bank detail template and vendor contact for finance

Next steps (from our side):
1) Confirm procurement system (Ariba/Coupa) and point of contact so we can accept an invite or send required info — please reply with POC.
2) I’ll update the MAP with dates you confirm and send an updated sheet.
3) We’ll queue finance for billing setup as soon as W-9 + banking details are received.

Attached: 20260224_MAP-draft.xlsx, ACME_W-9.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out on the timeline above.

Best,

- Acme uses Coupa for supplier onboarding. I will create a supplier request and send the invite link to Redwood (please provide the vendor email to accept the invite).

- Legal (James) will review the MSA/order form. I’ve looped him here; James, any initial concerns on timeline?

2) Our finance team prefers ACH — we’ll provide bank routing/account via secure portal.

I’ll follow up with the Coupa invite once I have the supplier request in the system.
